descriptionChirho: The act or offering of priestly consecration (literally 'filling the hand'), referring to the installation ceremony and its associated ram/sacrifices (Exodus 29, Leviticus 7-8); plural מִלֻּאִים used as a technical cultic term for the ordination rite.

A setting or mount for precious stones, literally 'filling' — the socket or bezel into which a gem is set; used of the gold filigree settings on the priestly ephod and breastplate (Exodus 25:7, 35:9, 35:27; 1 Chronicles 29:2).
